name: Shooting Victims (2006-Present)
description:
This dataset records individual shooting victims from 2006 to the present, with one row per victim. Each record links to a shooting incident through an incident key and a unique victim identifier, and includes demographic details: age group (under 18, 18-24, 25-44, 45-64, 65+), sex (predominantly male), and race/ethnicity (most commonly Black, followed by White Hispanic and Black Hispanic). A murder flag indicates whether the victim's injuries were fatal, with about 18% of sampled victims marked as homicides.

The data can support analyses of shooting violence patterns over time, demographic disparities among victims, and the share of shootings that result in death. It could be used by public safety agencies, researchers, and community organizations to examine trends, compare victim profiles across groups, and inform prevention and intervention planning. Because the sample is limited to 5,000 rows and some incidents involve multiple victims, counts should be interpreted with care
